title: RemoteTransform3d updates position when Use Global Coordinates is enabled regardless of the update position field
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5
- Not Reproducible in 4.4

### System information

Nixos 25.05, MESA 25.0.7,  kernel 6.17, KDE Plasma 6, Wayland, GPU: AMD 7800 XT, CPU: AMD ryzern 7 7800X3D

### Issue description

When "Use Global Coordinates" is enabled on remote transform 3d, the position is updated even when the update position is disabled. Also, this seems like a regression.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a Player with 2 bodies that need remote transform to keep the bodies in sync. 
In my case, the setup was 1 character body and a rigid body both with a remote transform3d and the root node holding both toggles the update position, and rotation.
In 4.4 this script would work and the bodies would toggle who is responsible to update the unused one, but in 4.5 it doesn't do that unless I also toggle the "use global coordinates" alongside with update position and rotation in the remote transform 3d

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'm currently working on the MRP, but the remote transform 3d behaviour change is visible in the engine's code. It is not guarded by the "update position"
4.4 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.4/scene/3d/remote_transform_3d.cpp#L100
4.5 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4.5/scene/3d/remote_transform_3d.cpp#L90-L100
